newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso firms as political fears subside.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso firms as political fears subside.

text.p: Colombia's peso clawed back three pesos to close at 1,128.8 against the dollar as political worries eased in the money markets, interbank traders said.
The rise comes a day after the currency dived 11.45 as foreign banks snapped up dollars amid fears that the government was losing ground in the country's long-running guerrilla war.
"The dollar rate dipped because banks which had built up long positions began to sell and the coffee sector was plowing export earnings into the market," one dealer said.
Demand for dollars came mostly from vehicle assemblers and the chemical sector.
The peso opened at 1,129 and hit an intraday low of 1,131.6 and a high of 1,126.3. Dealers reported 388 trades worth a total $194 million.
